#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/vibe-check
base=/workspace/vibe-check/tmp/performance-investigation-20261015
export TMPDIR="$base/process-tmp"
printf '%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$base/final-isolated-window-start.txt"
for runtime in node bun; do
  if [[ "$runtime" == node ]]; then command=(mise exec -- node); else command=(mise exec -- bun run); fi
  for script in measure survey maintenance-changes; do
    log="$base/$runtime-$script-final-isolated.log"
    if [[ "$script" == maintenance-changes ]]; then
      "${command[@]}" "$base/$script.ts" final-isolated > "$log" 2>&1
    else
      "${command[@]}" "$base/$script.ts" all final-isolated > "$log" 2>&1
    fi
  done
done
printf '%s\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$base/final-isolated-window-end.txt"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/vibe-check
base=/workspace/vibe-check/tmp/performance-investigation-20261015
out=/workspace/vibe-check/tmp/optimization-implementation-20261015/performance
export TMPDIR="$out/process-tmp"
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR"
for target in node-all-optimization-after node-survey-all-optimization-after bun-all-optimization-after bun-survey-all-optimization-after; do
  if [[ -e "$base/$target" ]]; then printf 'Refusing existing evidence target: %s\n' "$base/$target" >&2; exit 2; fi
done
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$out/window-start.txt"
trap 'code=$?; date -u +%FT%TZ > "$out/window-end.txt"; printf "%s\n" "$code" > "$out/window-exit-code.txt"; exit "$code"' EXIT
for runtime in node bun; do
  if [[ "$runtime" == node ]]; then command=(mise exec -- node); else command=(mise exec -- bun run); fi
  for script in measure survey; do
    if [[ "$script" == measure ]]; then limit=300; else limit=120; fi
    printf '%s %s %s start\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$runtime" "$script" >> "$out/process-status.txt"
    timeout "${limit}s" "${command[@]}" "$base/$script.ts" all optimization-after > "$out/$runtime-$script.log" 2>&1
    printf '%s %s %s exit=0\n' "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" "$runtime" "$script" >> "$out/process-status.txt"
  done
done
